summary: Full backend + frontend regression for iteration 2 (Waitlist + Stripe checkout + new Details/Buy sections + Success polling page). All 10 backend pytest tests pass. All 6 frontend flows (landing testids, Details scene at scrollY 6600, BuyBlock price/CTA, Waitlist form → confirmation + sonner toast, Success page polling → fallback + back-home nav, Buy CTA → real Stripe URL) verified against the live public URL.

waitlist.POST /api/waitlist (fresh): 200 status='subscribed', message present, email_sent=true (real Resend email fired via Emergent proxy)

checkout.POST /api/checkout/session (valid): 200 — url starts https://checkout.stripe.com/, session_id starts cs_test_, payment_transactions row persisted with payment_status='initiated', amount=349.0, currency=dkk

success_page_/success?session_id=cs_test.polling_exhausts_and_shows_fallback: after ~14s shows 'Still confirming.' fallback (not still polling)

buy_cta_click_flow.loading_state: button text switches to 'STARTING CHECKOUT' with spinner

critical_code_review_comments: Success.js polls up to 5 attempts (attempts variable starts at 0 and increments on entry) — final rendered text is 'attempt 0/5' briefly before first response; cosmetic only.

BuyBlock.js mounts <Toaster/> locally; toaster is unmounted when the buy section is off-screen. Currently fine because toasts only fire from within this section, but if waitlist submit ever moves elsewhere the toast won't show — consider a single root-level Toaster.
server.py checkout_status calls Stripe on every GET even after payment_status transitions to 'expired'/'complete' but not 'paid' — could add a short cache on terminal statuses; low priority.
server.py has no rate limiting on /api/waitlist — public endpoint, could be spammed. Consider IP throttling or simple cool-down. Not blocking.
Neither backend nor frontend enforces a max-scroll behaviour on ScrollExperience; framer-motion emits a benign non-static-position warning (already noted in iter_1).
test_credentials: none required — no auth in this app
seed_data_creation: Test waitlist rows created with TEST_ prefix and a few waitlist-fe-<timestamp>@nofilterlab.com rows from Playwright run; small number, safe to leave.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend base URL is REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. When running backend tests, source MONGO_URL / DB_NAME from backend/.env stripped of surrounding quotes (values are wrapped in " " in the env file). Live Stripe test key is configured — /api/checkout/session returns real cs_test_… sessions. DO NOT complete card entry on Stripe. Success page polls every 2s up to 5 times then shows 'Still confirming.' fallback. All new UI has data-testid attributes per the request; details scene sits around scrollY≈6600 on 1440-wide viewport.
rca of the issue: No issues found — implementation matches the review request end-to-end.
